# BAB I

## KETENTUAN UMUM

#### Pasal 1

Dalam Peraturan Daerah ini, yang dimaksud dengan:

1. Daerah adalah Kabupaten Kebumen.  
2. Bupati adalah Bupati Kebumen.  
3. Pemerintah Daerah adalah Bupati sebagai unsur penyelenggara Pemerintahan Daerah yang memimpin pelaksanaan urusan pemerintahan yang menjadi kewenangan daerah otonom.  
4. Dewan Perwakilan Rakyat Daerah yang selanjutnya disingkat DPRD adalah Dewan Perwakilan Rakyat Daerah Kabupaten Kebumen.  
5. Perangkat Daerah adalah unsur pembantu Bupati dan DPRD dalam urusan pemerintahan yang menjadi kewenangan daerah.  
6. Penyelenggaraan adalah pelaksanaan suatu hal yang dilakukan guna mencapai suatu tujuan.  
7. Perempuan adalah seseorang yang berjenis kelamin  perempuan mulai dari bayi, remaja, dewasa sampai dengan  lanjut usia, yang telah diakui oleh hukum.  
8. Pelindungan Perempuan adalah segala upaya yang  ditujukan untuk melindungi dan memberikan rasa aman  kepada perempuan serta pemenuhan haknya melalui  perhatian yang konsisten, terstruktur, dan sistematis yang  ditujukan untuk mencapai kesetaraan gender.  
9. Pemberdayaan Perempuan adalah upaya untuk  memperoleh akses dan kontrol terhadap sumber daya,  ekonomi, politik, sosial, budaya, agar perempuan dapat  mengatur diri dan meningkatkan rasa percaya diri untuk  mampu berperan dan berpartisipasi aktif dalam  memecahkan masalah, sehingga mampu membangun  kemampuan dan konsep diri.  
10. Diskriminasi terhadap Perempuan adalah setiap  perbedaan, pengucilan atau pembatasan yang dibuat atas  dasar jenis kelamin, yang mempunyai pengaruh atau  tujuan untuk mengurangi atau menghapuskan pengakuan,  penikmatan atau penggunaan hak-hak asasi manusia dan  kebebasan-kebebasan pokok di bidang politik, ekonomi,  sosial, budaya, sipil atau apapun oleh kaum perempuan,  terlepas dari status perkawinan mereka, atas dasar  persamaan antara laki-laki dan perempuan.  
11. Kesetaraan Gender adalah kondisi dan kedudukan yang  setara antara laki-laki dan perempuan untuk memperoleh  hak-haknya sebagai manusia, dalam mengakses dan  mengontrol sumber daya, berpartisipasi di seluruh proses  pembangunan dan pengambilan keputusan, serta memperoleh manfaat dari pembangunan.  
12. Kekerasan adalah setiap tindakan yang berakibat  timbulnya kesengsaraan atau penderitaan secara fisik,  seksual, mental, psikologis, termasuk intimidasi,  pengusiran paksa, ancaman tindakan tertentu, pemaksaan  atau perampasan kemerdekaan, penelantaran serta  menghalangi kemampuan untuk menikmati semua hak  dan kebebasannya.  
13. Kekerasan Terhadap Perempuan adalah setiap tindakan  berdasarkan perbedaan jenis kelamin yang berakibat atau  mungkin berakibat kesengsaraan atau penderitaan  perempuan secara fisik, seksual, dan psikologis, termasuk  ancaman tindakan tertentu, perampasan kemerdekaan  secara sewenang-wenang, baik yang terjadi di ranah privat  atau publik.  
14. Kekerasan Ekonomi adalah bentuk kekerasan di mana  pelaku mengontrol, memanipulasi, atau membatasi akses  korban terhadap sumber daya ekonomi dengan tujuan  mengendalikan dan mendominasi korban, meliputi  perbuatan: mengambil alih kendali penuh atas pendapatan korban, termasuk gaji, tabungan, atau bantuan keuangan  lain yang diterima korban, membatasi atau melarang  korban untuk memiliki atau menggunakan uang, sehingga  korban bergantung sepenuhnya pada pelaku untuk  kebutuhan finansial, melarang atau menghalangi korban  untuk bekerja atau melanjutkan pendidikan dengan tujuan  membatasi kemandirian finansial korban, menggunakan  aset atau harta korban untuk keuntungan pribadi atau  merusak aset tersebut sebagai bentuk hukuman, dan  membuat semua keputusan finansial tanpa melibatkan  korban, sehingga korban tidak memiliki kendali atas  keuangan rumah tangga.  
15. Kekerasan Fisik adalah setiap perbuatan yang  mengakibatkan rasa sakit, cedera, luka atau cacat pada  tubuh seseorang, gugurnya kandungan, pingsan dan atau  menyebabkan kematian.  
16. Kekerasan Psikis adalah perbuatan yang mengakibatkan  ketakutan, hilangnya rasa percaya diri, hilangnya  kemampuan untuk bertindak, rasa tidak berdaya dan/atau  penderitaan psikis lainnya pada seseorang.  
17. Kekerasan Seksual adalah setiap perbuatan berupa  perkosaan, perbuatan cabul, pemaksaan kontrasepsi,  pemaksaan sterilisasi, penyiksaan seksual, eksploitasi  seksual, perbudakan seksual, kekerasan seksual berbasis  elektronik, perbuatan melanggar kesusilaan yang  bertentangan dengan kehendak korban, pemaksaan  pelacuran, tindak pidana perdagangan orang yang  ditujukan untuk eksploitasi seksual dan bentuk kekerasan  seksual lainnya yang secara tegas disebut sebagai tindak  pidana kekerasan seksual sebagaimana diatur dalam  ketentuan peraturan perundang–undangan.  
18. Keluarga adalah unit terkecil dalam masyarakat yang  terdiri dari suami, istri, atau suami, istri dan anaknya, atau  ayah dan anaknya, atau ibu dan anaknya, atau keluarga  sedarah dalam garis lurus ke atas atau ke bawah sampai  dengan derajat ketiga.  
19. Rumah Tangga adalah suami, istri, anak, orang-orang yang  mempunyai hubungan keluarga karena hubungan darah,  perkawinan, persusuan, pengasuhan, dan perwakilan  perwalian, dan/atau pekerja rumah tangga dan menetap  dalam rumah tangga tersebut.  
20. Korban adalah perempuan yang mengalami kesengsaraan  dan atau penderitaan baik langsung maupun tidak  langsung sebagai akibat dari kekerasan.  
21. Hak Perempuan adalah seperangkat hak yang melekat pada  diri seorang perempuan atau kelompok orang untuk tidak  mengalami diskriminasi, kesengsaraan atau penderitaan  baik secara langsung maupun tidak langsung yang  dilakukan oleh aparat negara atau oleh negara atau oleh  aparat pemerintah daerah atau orang perorangan yang  merupakan hak kodrati yang diberikan oleh Tuhan Yang  Maha Esa.  
22. Pencegahan adalah segala upaya untuk mencegah tindak  kekerasan, eksploitasi dan diskriminasi terhadap  perempuan dan keberulangan terjadinya tindak kekerasan,  eksploitasi dan diskriminasi terhadap korban.  
23. Pelayanan adalah segala upaya dan tindakan untuk  memenuhi hak perempuan korban kekerasan, eksploitasi  dan diskriminasi terhadap perempuan yang meliputi  pelayanan pengaduan, kesehatan, rehabilitasi sosial,  bantuan dan penegakan hukum, pemulangan, reintegrasi  sosial, dan restitusi.  
24. Pemulihan Korban adalah segala upaya dan tindakan  penguatan kemampuan perempuan korban kekerasan,  eksploitasi dan diskriminasi secara fisik, psikis, hukum,  sosial, politik dan ekonomi sehingga mendapatkan  kehidupan yang bermartabat dan Sejahtera.  
25. Pelayanan Terpadu adalah penyelenggaraan layanan yang  terintegrasi, multi aspek, lintas fungsi dan sektor bagi  korban, warga korban, dan/atau saksi tindak pidana  kekerasan, eksploitasi dan diskriminasi.  
26. Pengaduan adalah serangkaian tindakan pelaporan yang  dilakukan oleh korban dan/atau pendamping kepada  penyelenggara Pusat Pelayanan Terpadu untuk  menindaklanjuti laporan adanya tindak kekerasan  terhadap korban kekerasan.  
27. Rehabilitasi Kesehatan adalah pemulihan korban  kekerasan dari gangguan kesehatan yang dideritanya. 28. Rehabilitasi Sosial adalah pelayanan yang ditujukan untuk memulihkan kondisi psikis dan mengembangkan  kemampuan seseorang yang mengalami disfungsi sosial  agar dapat melaksanakan fungsi sosialnya secara wajar.  
29. Bantuan Hukum adalah jasa hukum yang diberikan oleh  pendamping, aparat penegak hukum yang meliputi  pemberian konsultasi hukum, menjalankan kuasa,  mewakili, mendampingi, membela dan melakukan  tindakan hukum lain untuk korban kekerasan.  
30. Pemulangan adalah upaya mengembalikan korban  kekerasan dari wilayah penerima/terjadinya kekerasan ke  wilayah asal atau pihak keluarga.  
31. Reintegrasi Sosial adalah upaya untuk menyatukan  kembali korban kekerasan kepada keluarga, masyarakat,  lembaga atau lingkungan sosial lainnya yang dapat  memberikan pelindungan.  
32. Eksploitasi adalah tindakan dengan atau tanpa  persetujuan korban yang meliputi tetapi tidak terbatas  pada pelacuran, kerja atau pelayanan paksa, perbudakan  atau praktik serupa perbudakan, penindasan, pemerasan,  pemanfaatan fisik, seksual, organ reproduksi, atau secara  melawan hukum memindahkan atau mentransplantasi  organ dan/atau jaringan tubuh atau memanfaatkan tenaga  atau kemampuan seseorang oleh pihak lain untuk  mendapatkan keuntungan baik materiil maupun  immaterial.  
33. Diskriminasi sebagaimana yang dimaksud adalah setiap  pembatasan, pelecehan, atau pengucilan yang langsung  ataupun tak langsung didasarkan pada pembedaan  manusia atas dasar agama, suku, ras, etnik, kelompok,  golongan, status sosial, status ekonomi, jenis kelamin,  bahasa, keyakinan politik, yang berakibat pengurangan,  penyimpangan atau penghapusan pengakuan,  pelaksanaan atau penggunaan hak asasi manusia dan  kebebasan dasar dalam kehidupan baik individual maupun  kolektif dalam bidang politik, ekonomi, hukum, sosial,  budaya, dan aspek kehidupan lainnya.  
34. Unit Pelaksana Teknis Daerah Perlindungan Perempuan  dan Anak yang selanjutnya disingkat UPTD PPA adalah unit  pelaksana teknis operasional pada satuan kerja yang  menyelenggarakan urusan pemerintahan di bidang  pemberdayaan perempuan dan perlindungan anak, yang  berfungsi sebagai penyelenggara pelayanan terpadu bagi  perempuan dan anak yang mengalami kekerasan,  diskriminasi, dan masalah lainnya.  
35. Kelompok Perlindungan Perempuan Anak Desa/Kelurahan  selanjutnya disingkat KPPAD/KPPAK adalah lembaga  pelindungan perempuan dan anak berbasis masyarakat  yang berkedudukan dan melakukan kerja-kerja  pelindungan perempuan dan anak di wilayah  desa/kelurahan sesuai tempat tinggal.

# CHAPTER I

## GENERAL PROVISIONS

#### Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is Kebumen Regency.  
2. Regent is the Regent of Kebumen.  
3. Regional Government is the Regent as an element of the Regional Government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.  
4. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is the Regional House of Representatives of Kebumen Regency.  
5. Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Regent and DPRD in government affairs that are the authority of the region.  
6. Implementation is the execution of a matter carried out to achieve a goal.  
7. Woman is a person of female gender starting from infants, adolescents, adults up to the elderly, who has been recognized by law.  
8. Protection of Women is all efforts aimed at protecting and providing a sense of security to women as well as the fulfillment of their rights through consistent, structured, and systematic attention aimed at achieving gender equality.  
9. Empowerment of Women is an effort to obtain access and control over resources, economic, political, social, cultural, so that women can manage themselves and increase self-confidence to be able to play a role and actively participate in solving problems, so as to be able to build capacity and self-concept.  
10. Discrimination against Women is any distinction, exclusion or restriction made on the basis of sex, which has the effect or purpose of reducing or eliminating the recognition, enjoyment or exercise of human rights and fundamental freedoms in the political, economic, social, cultural, civil or any other field by women, regardless of their marital status, on the basis of equality between men and women.  
11. Gender Equality is an equal condition and position between men and women to obtain their rights as human beings, in accessing and controlling resources, participating in all development processes and decision-making, as well as obtaining benefits from development.  
12. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering physically, sexually, mentally, psychologically, including intimidation, forced eviction, threat of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of freedom, neglect and hindering the ability to enjoy all rights and freedoms.  
13. Violence Against Women is any act based on gender differences that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually, and psychologically, including threats of certain actions, arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the private or public sphere.  
14. Economic Violence is a form of violence in which the perpetrator controls, manipulates, or restricts the victim's access to economic resources with the aim of controlling and dominating the victim, including acts of: taking full control of the victim's income, including salary, savings, or other financial assistance received by the victim, restricting or prohibiting the victim from owning or using money, so that the victim is completely dependent on the perpetrator for financial needs, prohibiting or preventing the victim from working or continuing education with the aim of limiting the victim's financial independence, using the victim's assets or property for personal gain or damaging such assets as a form of punishment, and making all financial decisions without involving the victim, so that the victim has no control over household finances.  
15. Physical Violence is any act that causes pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage, fainting and or causes death.  
16. Psychological Violence is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and/or other psychological suffering to a person.  
17. Sexual Violence is any act in the form of rape, indecent acts, forced contraception, forced sterilization, sexual torture, sexual exploitation, sexual slavery, electronic-based sexual violence, acts violating decency that are contrary to the victim's will, forced prostitution, criminal acts of trafficking in persons intended for sexual exploitation and other forms of sexual violence that are expressly stated as criminal acts of sexual violence as regulated in the provisions of laws and regulations.  
18. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband, wife, or husband, wife and their children, or father and children, or mother and children, or blood relatives in a straight line upward or downward up to the third degree.  
19. Household is husband, wife, children, people who have family relationships due to blood relations, marriage, breastfeeding, foster care, and guardianship representation, and/or domestic workers and reside in that household.  
20. Victim is a woman who experiences misery and or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.  
21. Women's Rights are a set of rights inherent in a woman or group of people not to experience discrimination, misery or suffering either directly or indirectly committed by state apparatus or by the state or by regional government apparatus or individuals which are natural rights given by God Almighty.  
22. Prevention is all efforts to prevent acts of violence, exploitation and discrimination against women and the recurrence of acts of violence, exploitation and discrimination against victims.  
23. Services are all efforts and actions to fulfill the rights of women victims of violence, exploitation and discrimination against women which include complaint services, health, social rehabilitation, legal assistance and enforcement, repatriation, social reintegration, and restitution.  
24. Victim Recovery is all efforts and actions to strengthen the capacity of women victims of violence, exploitation and discrimination physically, psychologically, legally, socially, politically and economically so as to obtain a dignified and prosperous life.  
25. Integrated Services are the implementation of integrated, multi-aspect, cross-functional and cross-sectoral services for victims, victim community members, and/or witnesses of criminal acts of violence, exploitation and discrimination.  
26. Complaint is a series of reporting actions carried out by victims and/or companions to the Integrated Service Center organizers to follow up on reports of acts of violence against victims of violence.  
27. Health Rehabilitation is the recovery of victims of violence from the health problems they suffer. 28. Social Rehabilitation is a service aimed at restoring the psychological condition and developing the ability of a person experiencing social dysfunction to be able to carry out their social functions properly.  
29. Legal Aid is legal services provided by companions, law enforcement officers which include providing legal consultation, exercising power, representing, accompanying, defending and taking other legal actions for victims of violence.  
30. Repatriation is an effort to return victims of violence from the receiving area/area where violence occurred to the area of origin or family.  
31. Social Reintegration is an effort to reunite victims of violence with family, community, institutions or other social environments that can provide protection.  
32. Exploitation is an act with or without the victim's consent which includes but is not limited to prostitution, forced labor or services, slavery or practices similar to slavery, oppression, extortion, utilization of physical, sexual, reproductive organs, or unlawfully transferring or transplanting organs and/or body tissues or utilizing the labor or ability of a person by another party to obtain benefits both material and immaterial.  
33. Discrimination as referred to is any restriction, harassment, or exclusion that is directly or indirectly based on human differentiation on the basis of religion, ethnicity, race, ethnic group, group, class, social status, economic status, gender, language, political beliefs, which results in reduction, deviation or elimination of recognition, implementation or use of human rights and basic freedoms in life both individually and collectively in the political, economic, legal, social, cultural fields, and other aspects of life.  
34. Regional Technical Implementation Unit for the Protection of Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as UPTD PPA is an operational technical implementation unit in a work unit that organizes government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection, which functions as an organizer of integrated services for women and children who experience violence, discrimination, and other problems.  
35. Village/Sub-district Women and Children Protection Group hereinafter abbreviated as KPPAD/KPPAK is a community-based women and children protection institution that is domiciled and carries out women and children protection work in the village/sub-district area according to their place of residence.

## Bagian Keenam

Peningkatan Pemberdayaan Perempuan di Bidang Ketenagakerjaan

#### Pasal 20

Penyelenggaraan Pemberdayaan Perempuan di bidang  ketenagakerjaan sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 15  ayat (2) huruf c angka 5 dilaksanakan oleh Perangkat Daerah  yang menyelenggarakan urusan pemerintahan di bidang  tenaga kerja dan instansi terkait dalam bentuk:
a. pemberian keterampilan dan pelatihan kerja;  
b. perempuan memiliki kesempatan yang sama tanpa  diskriminasi untuk memperoleh pekerjaan; danc. pemberi kerja yang menggunakan tenaga kerja perempuan,  memberikan akses dan pelatihan keterampilan.

## Bagian Ketujuh

Peningkatan Pemberdayaan Perempuan di Bidang Politik dan  Pemerintahan

#### Pasal 21

1. Penyelenggaraan Pemberdayaan Perempuan di bidang politik  dan pemerintahan sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 15 ayat  (2) huruf c angka 6 dan angka 7 dilaksanakan oleh Perangkat  Daerah yang menyelenggarakan urusan pemerintahan di  bidang kesatuan bangsa dan politik, Perangkat Daerah dan  instansi terkait dalam bentuk:a. pengembangan kapasitas perempuan di bidang politik;  
b. pengembangan diri melalui organisasi untuk berserikat,  berkumpul, berpendapat;  
c. pelibatan perempuan dalam pengambilan keputusan  publik;  
d. pemberian akses bagi perempuan untuk menduduki  jabatan publik; dane. partisipasi dalam pemilihan umum, pemilihan kepala  daerah dan jabatan politik lainnya di Daerah.  
2. Pemerintah Daerah dan/atau partai politik bertanggung jawab  memberikan pendidikan politik bagi perempuan.

## Bagian Kedelapan

Peningkatan Pemberdayaan Perempuan di Bidang Sosial

#### Pasal 22

Penyelenggaraan Pemberdayaan Perempuan di bidang sosial  sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 15 ayat (2) huruf c angka 8  dilaksanakan oleh Perangkat Daerah yang menyelenggarakan  urusan pemerintahan di bidang sosial dan instansi terkait dalam  bentuk:
a. upaya penyadaran dan peningkatan kapasitas diri di bidang  sosial;  
b. pemberian dan pengembangan akses bagi perempuan untuk  berpartisipasi pada bidang sosial;  
c. peningkatan kompetensi perempuan melalui pelatihan dan  pendidikan sosial bagi perempuan;  
d. pelibatan perempuan dalam kegiatan sosial; dan  e. menumbuhkembangkan wadah atau lembaga perempuan  pada bidang sosial.

## Bagian Kesembilan

Peningkatan Pemberdayaan Perempuan di Bidang Kebudayaan

#### Pasal 23

Penyelenggaraan Pemberdayaan Perempuan di bidang  kebudayaan sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 15 ayat (2) huruf  c angka 9 dilaksanakan oleh Perangkat Daerah yang  menyelenggarakan urusan pemerintahan di bidang kebudayaan  dan instansi terkait dalam bentuk:
a. upaya penyadaran dan peningkatan kapasitas diri di bidang  kebudayaan;  
b. pemberian dan pengembangan akses bagi perempuan untuk  berpartisipasi pada bidang kebudayaan;  
c. peningkatan kompetensi perempuan melalui pelatihan dan  pendidikan literasi kebudayaan bagi perempuan;  
d. pelibatan perempuan dalam kegiatan kebudayaan; dan  e. menumbuhkembangkan wadah atau lembaga perempuan  pada bidang kebudayaan.

## Bagian Kesepuluh

Peningkatan Pemberdayaan Perempuan di Bidang Lingkungan Hidup

#### Pasal 24

Penyelenggaraan Pemberdayaan Perempuan di bidang lingkungan  hidup sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 15 ayat (2) huruf c  angka 10 dilaksanakan oleh Perangkat Daerah yang  menyelenggarakan urusan pemerintahan di bidang lingkungan  hidup dan instansi terkait dalam bentuk:
a. penyadaran dan pembentukan perilaku perempuan sadar  lingkungan hidup;  
b. peningkatan kapasitas dan kompetensi perempuan melalui  pelatihan dan pendidikan lingkungan hidup;  
c. pemberian dan pengembangan akses perempuan untuk  berpartisipasi di bidang lingkungan hidup;  
d. pelibatan perempuan dalam kegiatan lingkungan hidup; dan  e. menumbuhkembangkan wadah atau lembaga perempuan pada  bidang lingkungan hidup.

# BAB V

## KEWAJIBAN DAN TANGGUNG JAWAB PEMERINTAH DAERAH

#### Pasal 25

Kewajiban Pemerintah Daerah dalam penyelenggaraan pelindungan  dan pemberdayaan perempuan sebagai berikut:
a. menjamin terselenggaranya pemenuhan hak perempuan dan  pemberian jaminan rasa aman dari tindakan kekerasan,  eksploitasi dan diskriminasi terhadap perempuan di Daerah;  
b. menetapkan kebijakan, program, kegiatan penyelenggaraan  pelindungan dan pemberdayaan perempuan serta jaminan  penanganan korban untuk menghapus segala bentuk tindak  kekerasan, eksploitasi, dan diskriminasi terhadap perempuan  di Daerah; danc. memberikan pembinaan dan pengawasan dalam upaya  penyelenggaraan pelindungan dan pemberdayaan perempuan  yang dilakukan oleh Perangkat Daerah yang menyelenggarakan  urusan pemerintahan di bidang pemberdayaan perempuan.

#### Pasal 26

Pemerintah Daerah bertanggung jawab:

## Part Six

Enhancement of Women's Empowerment in the Field of Employment

#### Article 20

The implementation of Women's Empowerment in the field of employment as referred to in Article 15 paragraph (2) letter c number 5 shall be carried out by the Regional Apparatus administering governmental affairs in the field of manpower and related agencies in the form of:

a. provision of skills and job training;  
b. women have equal opportunities without discrimination to obtain employment; and

Enhancement of Women's Empowerment in the Field of Politics and Government

#### Article 21

1. The implementation of Women's Empowerment in the field of politics and government as referred to in Article 15 paragraph (2) letter c number 6 and number 7 shall be carried out by the Regional Apparatus administering governmental affairs in the field of national unity and politics, Regional Apparatus, and related agencies in the form of:

a. capacity building for women in the political field;  
b. self-development through organizations to associate, assemble, and express opinions;  
c. involvement of women in public decision-making;  
d. provision of access for women to hold public office; and  
e. participation in general elections, regional head elections, and other political offices in the Region.  

2. The Regional Government and/or political parties are responsible for providing political education for women.

## Part Eight

Enhancement of Women's Empowerment in the Social Sector

#### Article 22

The implementation of Women's Empowerment in the social sector as referred to in Article 15 paragraph (2) letter c number 8 shall be carried out by the Regional Apparatus administering governmental affairs in the social sector and related agencies in the form of:

a. awareness-raising efforts and enhancement of self-capacity in the social sector;  
b. provision and development of access for women to participate in the social sector;  
c. improvement of women's competence through training and social education for women;  
d. involvement of women in social activities; and  
e. fostering and developing forums or institutions for women in the social sector.

## Part Nine

Enhancement of Women's Empowerment in the Cultural Sector

#### Article 23

The implementation of Women's Empowerment in the cultural sector as referred to in Article 15 paragraph (2) letter c number 9 shall be carried out by the Regional Apparatus administering governmental affairs in the cultural sector and related agencies in the form of:

a. awareness-raising efforts and enhancement of self-capacity in the cultural sector;  
b. provision and development of access for women to participate in the cultural sector;  
c. improvement of women's competence through training and cultural literacy education for women;  
d. involvement of women in cultural activities; and  
e. fostering and developing forums or institutions for women in the cultural sector.

## Part Ten

Enhancement of Women's Empowerment in the Environmental Sector

#### Article 24

The implementation of Women's Empowerment in the environmental sector as referred to in Article 15 paragraph (2) letter c number 10 shall be carried out by the Regional Apparatus administering governmental affairs in the environmental sector and related agencies in the form of:

a. awareness-raising and formation of environmentally conscious behavior among women;  
b. enhancement of women's capacity and competence through environmental training and education;  
c. provision and development of women's access to participate in the environmental sector;  
d. involvement of women in environmental activities; and  
e. fostering and developing forums or institutions for women in the environmental sector.

# CHAPTER V

## OBLIGATIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE REGIONAL GOVERNMENT

#### Article 25

The obligations of the Regional Government in the implementation of the protection and empowerment of women are as follows:

a. ensuring the fulfillment of women's rights and providing guarantees of a sense of security from acts of violence, exploitation, and discrimination against women in the Region;  
b. establishing policies, programs, and activities for the implementation of the protection and empowerment of women as well as guarantees for handling victims to eliminate all forms of violence, exploitation, and discrimination against women in the Region; and  
c. providing guidance and supervision in efforts to implement the protection and empowerment of women carried out by the Regional Apparatus administering governmental affairs in the field of women's empowerment.

#### Article 26

The Regional Government is responsible for:

a. implementing policies, programs, and activities for the implementation of the protection and empowerment of women to ensure the fulfillment of women's rights;  
b. facilitating facilities and infrastructure for the implementation of the protection and empowerment of women; and  
c. applying service standards for the implementation of the protection and empowerment of women in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

# CHAPTER VI

## INSTITUTIONAL ARRANGEMENTS

## Part One

General

#### Article 27

In the context of implementing the protection and empowerment of women, the Regional Government establishes:

a. UPTD PPA;  
b. Women's and Children's Protection Forum;  
c. Village/Sub-district Women's and Children's Protection Group; and  
d. other women's protection and empowerment institutions in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

## Part Two

### UPTD PPA

#### Article 28

1. In an effort to provide and implement the handling of protection services for women victims of violence, exploitation, and discrimination, the Regional Government establishes UPTD PPA.  
2. The UPTD PPA as referred to in paragraph (1) is under and accountable to the head of the Regional Apparatus administering governmental affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection.  
3. Further provisions regarding the establishment, main duties and functions, and management of the UPTD PPA as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be regulated by a Regent Regulation.

## Part Three

Women's and Children's Protection Forum

#### Article 29

1. The Regional Government coordinates the handling of protection services for women victims of violence, exploitation, and discrimination at the sub-district level by establishing a women's and children's protection forum.  
2. The membership of the women's and children's protection forum as referred to in paragraph (1) consists of elements of the Sub-district, Sector Police, Military Rayon Command, Community Health Center, Office of Religious Affairs, and other elements.

## Part Four

Village/Sub-district Women's and Children's Protection Group

#### Article 30

1. In an effort to provide and implement the handling of protection services for women victims of violence, exploitation, and discrimination, the Regional Government establishes KPPAD/KPPAK.  
2. The KPPAD/KPPAK as referred to in paragraph (1) is under and accountable to the Regional Apparatus that carries out governmental affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection through the Village Head/Lurah with the knowledge of the local Camat.  
3. The KPPAD/KPPAK as referred to in paragraph (2) has the following duties:

a. conducting advocacy, mediation, outreach, and facilitation regarding the need to fulfill the rights of women and children, as well as the right of participation of women and children in development;  
b. collecting data and information related to the protection of women and children;  
c. receiving complaints from the public;  
d. conducting cooperation and coordination in implementing the fulfillment of the rights of women and children in accordance with the applicable laws and regulations; and  
e. making referrals in cases that cannot be resolved by KPPAD/KPPAK to UPTD PPA.  

4. Further provisions regarding the establishment, main duties and functions, and management of KPPAD/KPPAK as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be regulated in a Regent Regulation.

## COORDINATION AND COOPERATION

## Part One

Coordination

#### Article 31

In the context of implementing the protection and empowerment of women, the Regional Government carries out coordination with the central government, provincial government, other regency/city governments, related agencies, law enforcement institutions, service institutions, educational institutions, religious institutions, community social institutions, Islamic boarding schools, professional organizations, legal aid organizations, youth organizations, broadcasting supervisory institutions, media, communities, professional institutions, the business sector and other stakeholders.

## Part Two

Cooperation

#### Article 32

1. In the context of implementing the protection and empowerment of women, the Regional Government may conduct cooperation.  
2. Cooperation as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be implemented in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

# CHAPTER VIII

## PARTICIPATION

#### Article 33

1. Every person and/or legal entity may participate in the implementation of the protection and empowerment of women in the Region.  
2. Participation as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be carried out by individuals, groups or community social organizations, non-governmental organizations, educational institutions, law enforcement institutions, service institutions, religious institutions, Islamic boarding schools, professional organizations, legal aid organizations, youth organizations, broadcasting supervisory institutions, media, communities, professional institutions, the business sector and other related stakeholders.

b. taking preventive action against violence against women; andc. conducting skills training.

## MONITORING, EVALUATION, AND REPORTING

## Part One

Monitoring

#### Article 34

1. To ensure synergy, continuity and effectiveness in the implementation of policies, programs and activities for the implementation of the protection and empowerment of women, the Regional Government conducts monitoring.  
2. Monitoring as referred to in paragraph (1) is intended to determine the progress and obstacles in the implementation of policies, programs and activities for the implementation of the protection and empowerment of women in the Region.  
3. Monitoring as referred to in paragraph (2) shall be conducted periodically from the planning stage up to the policies, programs and activities for the implementation of the protection and empowerment of women for the current year.

## Part Two

Evaluation

#### Article 35

1. Evaluation of the implementation of policies, programs and activities for the protection and empowerment of women shall be conducted by the Regional Apparatus implementing governmental affairs in the field of women's empowerment on a regular basis.  
2. The results of the evaluation of the implementation of policies, programs and activities for the implementation of the protection and empowerment of women shall be used as input for the formulation of policies, programs and activities.

## Part Three

Reporting

#### Article 36

1. To improve coordination of service delivery to women in the Region, the Regional Apparatus implementing governmental affairs in the field of women's empowerment shall submit reports to the Regent.  
2. Reporting as referred to in paragraph (1) shall include the implementation of handling issues of protection and empowerment of women in the Region.

# CHAPTER X

## AWARDS

#### Article 37

1. The Regent grants awards to persons, educational institutions, religious institutions, health service provider institutions, professional institutions and the business sector, service institutions, Islamic boarding schools, youth organizations, legal aid organizations, communities, and media that have rendered meritorious service in efforts to implement the protection and empowerment of women;  
2. Further provisions regarding the procedures for granting awards shall be regulated in a Regent Regulation.

# CHAPTER XI

## FUNDING

#### Article 38

Funding for the implementation of the protection and empowerment of women in the Region shall be sourced from:

a. the Regional Revenue and Expenditure Budget; and/or b. other lawful and non-binding sources in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

Implementing regulations of this Regional Regulation must be stipulated no later than 1 (one) year from the promulgation of this Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation shall come into force on the date of promulgation.
